1.plot: Cap'n Turbot got The Flounder stuck on some rocks. If the PAW Patrol doesn't save him, The Flounder will sink to the bottom of the bay!

1.plot: Santa's sleigh crashes and breaks in a snow storm on Christmas Eve, and all the presents are strewn across Adventure Bay. It's up to the PAW Patrol to fix the sled, collect the reindeer, find the gifts, find the magic star, and most importantly, save Christmas for Adventure Bay.

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E31 - Pups On Ice
1.plot: Ryder and the PAW Patrol need to rescue Alex on Jakes mountain.

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E33 - Pups Save a Super Pup
FR - PAW Patrol - S01E35 - Pups Go All Monkey
1.plot: An escaped baby monkey named Mandy leads the PAW Patrol on a chase through Adventure Bay, when she steals Mr. Porter van full of bananas.

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E37 - Pups Save a Bat
1.plot: A baby Bat decides to take a nap hanging from the Town Hall's bell and Mayor Goodway can't ring it. Ryder and the Pups attempt to rescue the bat quietly so it doesn't wake up, but it does and causes trouble around town. It's up to Ryder and the Pups to get the Bat and return her to her Bat cave.

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E39 - Pups Save the Easter Egg Hunt
1.plot: It’s Adventure Bay’s annual Easter Egg Hunt and the pups are helping Mayor Goodway with the egg decorating. The hunt for a very special egg leads Ryder and the PAW Patrol on an exciting adventure.

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E40 - Pups and the Lighthouse Boogie
1.plot: Cap'n Turbot has accidentally locked himself inside the lighthouse, so it is up to the pups to rescue a rowboat drifting out to sea.

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E42 - Pups Great Race
1.plot: It's Adventure Bay Race Day and the pups are about to race each other all across the town to see who is the fastest pup. One other competitor unexpectedly shows up though, Alex in his super trike!

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E44 - Pups and the Beanstalk
1.plot: Rubble has a wondrous dream, similar to Jack and the Beanstalk, where Marshall grows a giant beanstalk and Alex is a giant. However, when giant Alex starts to cause havoc, Ryder and the PAW Patrol must keep him occupied.

1.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S01E46 - Pups Save the Camping Trip
1.plot: When Chickaletta falls in a cave in the ground it's up to the PAW Patrol to save her!

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E01 - Pups Save the Space Alien
2.plot: An alien lands on Earth at Farmer Yumi's place, and the gang try to repair his spaceship so he can return home.

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E02 - Pups Save a Flying Frog
2.plot: Marshall gets a pet frog, and it jumps into a helicopter prior to a big frog-jumping competition.

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E03 - Pups and the Pirate Treasure
2.plot: Cap'n Turbot accidentally stumbles into a secret cavern that was once a pirate's hideout. When the PAW Patrol rescues him, they find an incomplete treasure map. The adventure is on as the pups follow clues to find the missing map pieces, and eventually to an amazing sunken pirate treasure!

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E04 - Pups Save the Penguins
2.plot: The pups must find a way to get a group of penguins back to the South Pole.

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E05 - Pups Save a Dolphin Pup
2.plot: The PAW Patrol must help a Baby Dolphin get back into the bay with her parents.

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E06 - Pups Save Jake
2.plot: The PAW Patrol must rescue Jake when his ankle gets stuck between some fallen rocks.

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E07 - Pups Save the Parade
2.plot: Katie's bathtub float floats away when Alex puts too many balloons on it during Adventure Bay Day.

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E08 - Pups Save the Diving Bell
2.plot: The PAW Patrol uses Zuma's new submarine to help Cap'n Turbot.

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E09 - Pups Save the Beavers
2.plot: When a storm washes away Chompy the Beaver's dam, he starts chomping wood all over town.

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E10 - Pups Save a Ghost
2.plot: A mysterious Ghost is causing havoc around the Lookout at night. The Pups and Chase in his new SPY GEAR set up a stakeout to bust it.

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E11 - Pups Save a Show
2.plot: The Pups are going to put on a Medieval play in town square, but Cap'n Turbot's castle stage prop ends up collapsing and trapping him!

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E13 - Pups Save a Wedding
2.plot: Farmer Al and Farmer Yumi are getting married! Farmer Yumi's barn is being decorated for the big day and all the pups are helping, but a big storm blows in and takes down a wall of the barn!

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E14 - The New Pup
2.plot: An Arctic storm picks up, but Jake finds help from a brave mountain ranger pup named Everest!

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E15 - Pups Jungle Trouble
2.plot: The PAW Patrol heads to the Jungle in the PAW Patroller to meet Ryder's 10 year old pen-pal, Carlos.

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E16 - Pups Save a Herd
2.plot: Chase is taking part in a herding competition and starts to herd people around town as practice which causes more trouble than good.

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E17 - Pups and the Big Freeze
2.plot: A wintertime storm causes trouble all over Adventure Bay.

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E18 - Pups Save a Basketball Game
2.plot: Marshall is nervous about playing in the PAW Patrol basketball team. Chase lets Marshall sit out, but when Zuma and Rocky get injured, Marshall is forced to take over.

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E19 - Pups Save a Talent Show
2.plot: It's Adventure Bay Talent Show Day! Mayor Goodway is excited but afraid there won't be enough acts! Ryder's super talented pups can definitely help out.

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E20 - Pups Save the Corn Roast
2.plot: Ryder and the Pups help Farmer Al prepare his annual Corn Roast, complete with a Corn Field Maze! Bettina accidentally tips over some hot BBQ coals onto the piles of corn that begin to pop, pop, POP into piles of POPCORN!

2.title: FR - PAW Patrol - S02E21 - Pups Leave Marshall Home Alone
2.plot: Ryder and the Pups head out for a day of Parachute training, but Marshall decides to stay back because of his fear of heights.

Cap'n Turbot and Ryder help out by diving deep to bottom of the Bay in their Diving Bell to help a Mer Mom and pup.

2.plot: The PAW Patrol must track down some loose penguins and help them return to the land of ice and snow.

With the help from Tuck and Ella, the Mighty Pups use a piece of the meteor to stop the three baddies and save the meteor.

It is up to the pups to get the baby dinosaurs back to their mothers on a Dino Rescue.

1.plot: To regain his detective status, Cole Ellis, a demoted by-the-book cop, is assigned to work with Max Mitchell, a spirited con artist whose charismatic street smarts could help catch an elusive thief.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E02 - Show Me the Murder
1.plot: A community outreach lecture on porch pirates turns into a murder investigation when Max and Ellis find an elite sports agent dead in his condo. Max’s dad George gives her advice – from his jail cell.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E03 - Howl to Get Away with Murder
1.plot: Things go from quaint to creepy when Max and Ellis look into the disappearance of a butcher in a small rural town. The duo gets a lesson in team building and Max quizzes Ellis on his personal life.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E04 - Strangers on a Wave
1.plot: When a surfer is mysteriously killed, Detectives Simmons and Yates are assigned the case. But it’s Ellis who grabs a board and goes undercover, taking a page out of Max’s book of disguise.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E05 - The Accountant of Monte Cristo
1.plot: When Ellis’s federal agent ex-girlfriend loses an accountant scheduled to testify against the mob, she enlists their help to find him before the accountant ends up sleeping with the fishes.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E06 - Dead of Night
1.plot: When the leads of THE most popular vampire show on TV become the target of a stalker, Max and Ellis enter the world of showbiz where the behind-the-scenes drama is even wilder than what’s on screen.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E07 - Con With the Wind
1.plot: George gets a 3-day pass from jail to spend with Max but the urge to pull one more con is real. Ellis helps a troubled youth charged with a B&E after he discovers it’s a teen his brother used to know.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E08 - Eternal Sunshine of the Therapized Mind
1.plot: When a celebrated therapist and best-selling author is murdered, a bickering Max and Ellis go undercover as a married couple at her wellness retreat and discover more than their chakras.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E09 - Inside (Con)Man
1.plot: Max visits the bank to access her safe deposit box but instead becomes a hostage in a dangerous robbery. Ellis defies Chief Li's orders to wait for the Tactical Response Team, knowing Max is inside.

1.title: FR - Wild Cards - S01E10 - Romancing the Egg
1.plot: Ellis is drawn into a case involving Max, her ex, and a world-famous Imperial egg, where a cat-and-mouse heist tests their friendship, their partnership, and their trust in each other.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E01 - Con in 60 Seconds
2.plot: Begrudgingly, Ellis comes to terms with Max's betrayal knowing she risked it all to share info about his brother's killer; now assigned to a new case, they dive into a high-speed street racing ring.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E02 - Once a Con a Time in the West
2.plot: Max and Ellis saddle up for a wild west adventure as they track down the attempted murderer of a ranch family's stud horse and uncover a dark family secret.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E03 - The Lorne Identity
2.plot: A paranoid biomedical engineer with a case of amnesia comes to Ellis for help leading the team down a trail of conspiracies, corruption and secret codes.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E04 - Dial 'A' for Alibi
2.plot: Stuck at home with a sprained ankle and a pair of binoculars, Max is convinced she has witnessed a murder while snooping on the condo across the street.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E05 - Catch Me if You Con
2.plot: Max's childhood bestie visits, pulling her into her old con ways. While Ellis investigates the murder of a former tennis pro, the BFFs go undercover to find the killer.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E06 - Seance and Sensibility
2.plot: Max and Ellis investigate a mysterious murder among an eccentric family where everyone is a suspect with riches on the line. Max adopts a psychic persona and holds a séance to summon the true killer.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E07 - The Big Bang Theory
2.plot: When Chief Li and Max are trapped in a hostage situation, Ellis tries to save them without letting his emotions cloud his judgement.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E08 - Death By Design
2.plot: When the head of a popular streetwear clothing brand is found dead, Max and Ellis find themselves investigating a murder within the world of haute couture, fashion models, and overworked assistants.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E09 - Barking Bad
2.plot: A murdered dog show judge leads Max and Ellis to a traveling dog competition to sniff out the killer. Ellis and his cat Marc move in temporarily with Max and Ricky while Ellis' boat is under repair.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E10 - Our Lip (Fillers) Are Sealed
2.plot: Max and Ellis go undercover, joining the cast and crew of a reality show to find out who murdered its star. In a world of scandal, deceit and lip-filler parties, every cast member is under suspicion.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E11 - Bride and Doom
2.plot: Max and Ellis are pulled into the undercover world of espionage and counterintelligence when a bride becomes the target of an unusual murder attempt on her wedding day.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E12 - Clouds In My Eyes
2.plot: Ellis gets new information that leads him to a jazz club and possibly the person responsible for Daniel's death. Max poses as a singer at the club to gather intel. George goes before the parole board.

2.title: FR - Wild Cards - S02E13 - Sunrise Sunset
2.plot: Ellis makes a shocking discovery about the criminal kingpin responsible for Daniel's death, and who is protecting him. Max, George and Ricky try to solve the cryptic clues hidden in Ashford's office.

1.title: FR - L'Affaire Asunta - S01E01 - September 21
1.plot: Rosario and Alfonso report their adopted daughter, Asunta, as missing. But what police assume is a kidnapping quickly spirals into something sinister.

1.title: FR - L'Affaire Asunta - S01E02 - September 24
1.plot: The investigation discloses unexpected details about Rosario's love life. A new testimony goes over Asunta's last months and points to alarming signs.

1.title: FR - L'Affaire Asunta - S01E03 - September 26
1.plot: As questions and evidence mount, public opinion turns against Rosario and Alfonso, whose relationship proves to be more turbulent than it looked.

1.title: FR - L'Affaire Asunta - S01E04 - September 28
1.plot: The defense attorney switches gears and reveals that Asunta had been targeted in the past. However, the new evidence seems off to Judge Malvar.

1.title: FR - L'Affaire Asunta - S01E05 - 24 Hours
1.plot: Detectives piece together theories about Asunta's death, her complicated relationship with her parents and Rosario and Alfonso's co-dependency.

1.title: FR - L'Affaire Asunta - S01E06 - The Trial
1.plot: Pressure builds on both sides as evidence and key testimonies are scrutinized in court. A new set of eyes on the case could sway the verdict.

meta.plot: Après avoir signalé la disparition de leur fille Asunta, âgée de 12 ans, des parents se retrouvent rapidement visés par l'enquête.

1.title: FR - La Villa Vanderpump - S01E01 - Welcome to Chateau Rosabelle
1.plot: For months, Lisa Vanderpump has meticulously curated her latest business venture: a chateau in the South of France. But when the first guests check in for a luxury experience, will the new staff be able to provide the service that meets Lisa’s standards?

1.title: FR - La Villa Vanderpump - S01E02 - No Room for Error
1.plot: Upon learning of a huge argument in front of the guests, Lisa sets her staff straight. With the marquee event less than 24 hours away, can the staff put aside their differences and come together to help the Guest of Honor pull off a secret proposal?

1.title: FR - La Villa Vanderpump - S01E03 - From One Queen to Another
1.plot: The Chateau welcomes a close circle of friends who are celebrating a ‘Rebirth’ party. Eric attempts to navigate managing duties while receiving pushback from Stephen and Lisa. Two ladies in the staff develop romantic feelings for the same co-worker.

1.title: FR - La Villa Vanderpump - S01E04 - A Naughty Night in Versailles
1.plot: One staff member’s antics reach a new high, causing a rift in the back of the house. But when a new group of guests arrive with their own set of issues, lines become blurred, and the drama spills over to the front of the house.

1.title: FR - La Villa Vanderpump - S01E05 - Revenge of Les Dames
1.plot: When a group of eligible bachelors arrive for a stay in the Chateau, the ladies in the staff could not be more thrilled to make the male staff a little jealous. Marciano finds himself in hot water with just about everyone after a night of debauchery.

1.title: FR - La Villa Vanderpump - S01E06 - An Unforgettable Night in Carcassonne
1.plot: While things heat up romantically between two staff members, another employee begins to isolate themselves. But when sparks fly at a festive dinner in town, ugly truths are revealed, making everyone question their relationships in the chateau.

1.title: FR - La Villa Vanderpump - S01E07 - A Divorce Party
1.plot: After an explosive dinner in town, lines are crossed, and one staff member questions their future at the chateau. When a new group of guests shows up to celebrate their divorce, old memories resurface, sending another staff member into a downward spiral.

1.title: FR - La Villa Vanderpump - S01E08 - Love, Death, and Beyond
1.plot: The Chateau welcomes a guest of honor who wants to celebrate her 30’s and say goodbye to her tumultuous 20’s by having a funeral service. Meanwhile, Hannah tries to navigate some of her own past insecurities with relationships, and Marciano.

1.title: FR - La Villa Vanderpump - S01E09 - Reunited and It Feels So Good
1.plot: A recent staff member’s arrival continues to ruffle some feathers, while another employee sees an opportunity for the taking. When a seasoned group of guests shows up to the villa, they breathe new life into the Chateau.

meta.plot: Dans un château français, les membres du personnel tentent d'offrir aux invités des expériences luxueuses, conçues par Vanderpump, tout en gérant les rivalités, les romances et les mésaventures qui en découlent.
